literal: If the nobility of noble people diminishes, the vast earth itself indeed will not bear its burden.
translation: If the exemplary character of noble people should diminish, even this vast earth would be unable to bear its own burden.
modern: சான்றோர்களின் நற்பண்பு குறைந்து போனால், இந்தப் பெரிய பூமியானது தன் பாரத்தைத் தாங்க மாட்டாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme importance of virtuous people in sustaining the world. The poet states that the vast earth (இருநிலம்) is able to bear its heavy burden (பொறை) only because of the moral strength of noble individuals. If the nobility of character (சான்றாண்மை) of these exemplary people (சான்றவர்) begins to decline (குன்றின்), the spiritual and moral foundation of the world is lost, and the physical earth itself will no longer be able to sustain its existence.
